title: Live&Life
description: You can plant,go fishing,make your world
body: Welcome to play the Live&Life  modpack, a Fabric-based modpack. You can farm, relax, and build machinery. We only provide you with the canvas, and it’s up to you to explore freely. Whether you want to farm, build, or go on adventures, Live&Life also includes the Sky mod for more exploration possibilities, running on version 1.20.1 Fabric. If you have any questions, feel free to let me know, and I’ll make adjustments in time. Since I don’t have a team, updates and fixes may be slow, please understand. As this modpack uses Fabric as the loader, the current content is relatively small. We plan to release a NeoForge version in the future, so stay tuned!
